x: Our performances in the last few winters have been solid and we have established ourselves as a "top half of the league" team, but if we want to win it we are going to have to come out with all guns blazing in race one. R.Collier, K.Taylor and P.Doorgachurn also ran but positions unknown.

At the same time junior Roy Collier was trying to tame a huge stadium pole as he equalled his pb in the pole vault; with both our main jumpers injured Roy answered a late call up.
Sixteen year old Roy Collier won the pole vault with 2.60 metres, and was fourth in the high jump clearing the same height (1.65, pb) as the second and third jumpers but having more failures.

Middle distance runner Jamie MacRae demonstrated that 800m is his better event with another fine run, clocking 2:05.5 to gain second B spot. Roy Collier took one vault (2.20) to place third, and then concentrated on the high jump competition in which he gained equal second.
